test_item_verbatim: When not equipped with a camera app but equipped with “enhanced camera app” the rear view will have the SVC bar present in the view

tcs.tc_title: SVC bar present in the rear view with enhanced camera app
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. PROXI Surround_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
4. PENDING: DR-CAM-r the equipment flag for the "Enhanced Camera App" feature is not sourced
5. The rear view camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the rear view camera image and check that the SVC bar is present in the view
2. Read the SVC bar and check that its soft controls are selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. The SVC bar is shown in the rear view camera image
2. The soft controls in the SVC bar can be selected
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: SVC bar present in the rear view with enhanced camera app
tcs.test_item:
When not equipped with a camera app but equipped with “enhanced camera app” the rear view will have the SVC bar present in the view

(SVC bar present in the rear view with enhanced camera app)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 §6.7.1 之 SVC bar 一支。`SVC bar` 為該列 Description 之逐字用語；其可選性取 H 本 **§22.2.13**（`All views listed above will have the black bar with all soft controls present when accessed via Vehicle Surround View, soft control via the controls page, or apps drawer`）。SVC bar 之存在以 `PROXI Surround_View_Camera = 1` 為前提；Toro 缺 byte 177（**DR-CAM-l**）→ `Toro(2261)` 判 0。
